2611: Adjust the seat of the machine so that your knees are at a 90-degree angle when your feet are on the footplate.
Sit on the machine with your back against the backrest and your feet shoulder-width apart on the footplate.
Place your hands on the handles or sides of the machine for stability.
Push the footplate away from your body by extending your leg, keeping your back against the backrest.
Pause for a moment at the fully extended position, then slowly bend your leg to return to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions, then switch legs.
2612: Hold the handles of the jump rope with your hands, palms facing inward.
Stand with your feet shoulder-width apart and knees slightly bent.
Swing the rope over your head and jump over it as it comes towards your feet.
Land softly on the balls of your feet and repeat the jump as the rope comes around again.
Continue jumping for the desired duration or number of repetitions.
2616: Sit down on the cable pulldown machine and grab the v-bar attachment with an overhand grip.
Adjust the knee pad so that your thighs are secured under it.
Keep your back straight and lean back slightly.
Pull the v-bar down towards your upper chest while keeping your elbows close to your body.
Squeeze your back muscles at the bottom of the movement.
Slowly return the v-bar to the starting position and repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
2656: Stand facing the cable with the handle at low height and grip it with one hand, palm up.
Keep your elbow tucked at your side.
Curl the handle toward your shoulder and squeeze the biceps.
Lower slowly until the arm is nearly straight.
Finish all reps, then switch arms.
2658: Step onto the elliptical and hold the handles.
Start striding in a smooth, ski-like rhythm, swinging your arms with your legs.
Stay upright and keep your core engaged.
Hold a steady pace for your chosen time.
2659: Adjust the seat so the handles are level with your upper chest.
Sit back and grip the handles with feet flat on the floor.
Press forward until your arms are nearly straight.
Squeeze the chest, then return slowly.
Keep your back against the pad and your shoulders down.
2660: Adjust the seat so your upper arms rest flat on the pad.
Grip the handles with palms up.
Curl the handles toward your shoulders.
Squeeze at the top, then lower slowly.
Do not lift your elbows off the pad or let the weight drop.
2661: Sit at the cable row station with your feet on the platform and knees slightly bent.
Grip the V bar and sit tall with arms extended.
Pull the bar toward your lower ribs and squeeze your shoulder blades.
Return slowly until your arms are straight.
Keep your chest up and avoid rocking.
2662: Adjust the seat and chest pad so you can grip the handles with arms extended.
Sit tall with your chest on the pad.
Pull the handles down and back, driving the elbows toward your hips.
Return slowly and keep your shoulders down.
2663: Adjust the seat and chest pad so you can grip the handles with arms extended.
Sit tall with your chest on the pad.
Pull the handles down and back, driving the elbows toward your hips.
Return slowly and keep your shoulders down.
2664: Adjust the seat so the handles line up with your mid chest.
Sit with your chest against the pad and grip the handles.
Pull your elbows back and squeeze the shoulder blades.
Keep your torso tight against the pad.
2665: Adjust the seat and thigh pad, then grip the wide handles.
Sit tall with your chest up.
Pull the handles down toward your upper chest, leading with the elbows.
Squeeze the lats, then let the handles rise slowly.
Avoid leaning far back or using momentum.
2666: Sit with the balls of your feet on the platform and the pad over your thighs.
Release the safety and lower your heels for a stretch.
Press up through the balls of your feet as high as you can.
2671: Set the bar at knee height and grip it with hands close together.
Hinge forward at the hips with a flat back and slightly bent knees.
Pull the bar toward your lower ribs, keeping elbows close to your body.
Squeeze your back at the top.
Lower the bar under control to full arm extension.
2683: Sit and rest your forearms on your thighs or a bench, palms down, holding a barbell.
Let your wrists drop so the bar hangs down.
Extend your wrists to raise the bar as high as you can.
Lower slowly and keep your forearms still.
2689: Stand facing away from a low cable pulley with the handle in one hand.
Keep your arm nearly straight and raise it forward to shoulder height.
Finish your reps, then switch arms.
2690: Stand holding a dumbbell in one hand at your side.
Keep a soft bend in the elbow.
Raise the arm out to the side until it reaches shoulder height.
Do all reps, then switch sides.
